column1: # retired-review-model.tsv — the DECLARED source of truth for the review models
# this repo has DELETED, and which no document it ships may teach again.
# Why a declaration and not a list inside the test: the guard, the corpus it is
# asserted over, and its positive controls are all DERIVED from this file. Adding
# a row here arms that model against every document in the /review closure at
# once AND forces a control proving the new pattern can actually fire. The test
# holds no pattern and no probe of its own, so a model nobody has thought of yet
# is one row away from being guarded everywhere.
# Columns, TAB separated:
#   id          stable name, unique
#   pattern     ERE, matched against each document FLATTENED to a single line, so
#               a claim that WRAPS across a line break is still caught — the bug
#               that let the last copy of this model ship green
#   probe       the prose that actually shipped this model, recovered VERBATIM
#               from git at the provenance below. printf %b escapes: \n is a line
#               break. Never invent a probe: a control you wrote yourself only
#               proves the pattern matches itself. The suite verifies each probe
#               against its provenance object, so an invented one cannot pass.
#   provenance  <rev>:<path> the probe was recovered from
